basic_info.description: Prime Noe Valley! Private garden oasis! This extraordinary, state-of-the-art, newly built two-story townhouse-style home lives like a single-family home with private entrance, elevator, and interior access to the garage. Located on a flat block. Spanning 2,655 sqft, it features high-end curated amenities, timeless design, & meticulous attention to detail. The stunning reverse floor plan places the main living area on the garden level, offering direct walk-out access to a beautifully landscaped private backyard. The open floor plan w/ gorgeous chef's kitchen, dining, and living areas flow together in a spectacular open space anchored by a massive island topped with stunning Lilac Da Vinci marble. A dramatic Kelly Wearstler light fixture, premium Thermador appliances, custom cabinetry, recessed lighting, & hdwd floors elevate the space. A powder rm & lg laundry rm complete the first floor. Upstairs, the sun-filled upper floor includes a luxurious primary suite w/ spa bathrm & an incredible walk-out deck overlooking the garden & connecting directly to the yard, a second ensuite bdrm, & an ensuite den w/ closet. 1 lg PKG w/ EV outlet. Exceptional TIC in a 2-unit bldg w/ TIC agreements available. Prime location near 24th St. shops & restaurants. Walk Score 99!
